dct_description_sm: This poll examines whether Canadians have their own family doctor, and among those that do - how easy or difficult it is to see the GP when needed; access to health care; how Canadians feel about the health care system both federally and provincially; and the attention health care has received in the 2015 Federal Election.
dct_title_s: Election 2015: The Politics of Health Care [Canada]
